LanguageData.Gun_Zastava_M70A_RWP.label: Zastava M70 A
LanguageData.Gun_Zastava_M70A_RWP.description: The Zastava M70 A is a rugged, semi-automatic pistol originating from Eastern Europe. Known for its durability and reliability, it boasts a 9mm caliber, offering a solid balance between stopping power and control. Its simple design ensures ease of use and maintenance, making it a trusty sidearm for any colonist.
